title: Domination
summary: A long war for the whole solar system: take its 40 areas one by one and wipe out the other players. It saves itself.
text:
**DOMINATION** on the title screen opens a war for the whole system against 1 to 3 computer players (Easy, Normal or Hard). You start at Touchdown; each of them starts on another planet. Every other area is held by **natives**, wildlife and old defences you have to beat first. You win when no one else holds an area.

**The map.** Every world with areas is drawn flat: west to east across, north up. Each area is a circle in its holder's colour (grey for natives) with the army there in it. A frame round it means **guns**, a triangle on top a **Launch Gantry**, dots under it its **level**. A red pulsing ring means a fight is going on there.

**Tap an area** to see it. In your own areas you can build, one job at a time (up to three queued, paid when you queue them; nothing gets built while the area is under attack):

- **ARMY**: +10 strength. How much army you can have grows with the areas you hold
- **GUNS**: +10 defences. They stay put and hit a quarter harder than an army
- **DEVELOP**: the area's level, up to 3. Each area makes 1 alloy a second, plus 1 per level, for your whole empire
- **GANTRY**: lets armies launch from here to any area on another world

**Moving.** Under *Send the army*, pick **ALL** or **HALF**, then tap one of the ringed areas: its neighbours on the same world, and with a gantry every area elsewhere. Armies take a while to get there (longer by launch to a far world) and can't be stopped on the way. If your army arrives where someone else is, they fight until one side is gone; the winner takes the area, which loses a level and its gantry. An area with nothing in it falls at once, so leave a garrison where enemies can reach you.

**Time.** ❚❚ pauses (or Space), and ▶▶ and ▶▶▶ run 3 or 10 times as fast. The war **autosaves** to this browser, so DOMINATION → CONTINUE picks it up. **Menu → Save & load** (or Ctrl+S) keeps save files by name, as for the campaign; LOAD on the title screen opens them too.

This is a preview: the war is fought on the strategy map, and fighting a battle yourself in an area comes in a later update.
